<user_query>
Explore frontend Vue app for chat planning. Return concise findings with file paths: 1) how page navigation/active key works in App.vue (no router?), 2) existing API client patterns (supabase.js, fetch wrappers), 3) branch/campus state handling (currentBranch, app_branch, useBranches), 4) any real-time libraries already present, 5) best insertion point for new Chat page and minimal shared components. Thoroughness: medium.
</user_query>

Exploring the Vue frontend for navigation, API patterns, branch state, real-time deps, and where a Chat page would fit.

[REDACTED]

## Findings (frontend Vue — chat planning)

### 1) Page navigation / active key — no Vue Router

- **`/home/admin/frontend/src/main.js`** — only `createApp(App).mount('#app')`; no `vue-router`.
- **`/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue`** — navigation is a string **`active`** ref (default `'director'`, see ~496) and **`setActivePage(page)`** (~585–593) that sets `active.value` (with password-lock and calendar reset-token tweaks).
- **`sidebarNavGroups`** computed (~633+) defines **role-based** nav: each item has a **`page`** key (e.g. `'director'`, `'notifications'`, `'calendar'`, …). Sidebar buttons call `setActivePage(item.page)`; **`v-if="active === '...'"`** in the main area (~202+) mounts the matching page component.
- **Mobile**: `mobileTabItems` (~509–528) uses the same **`page`** keys; “More” sheet reuses `sidebarNavGroups`.
- **URL**: only a **special case** for parent portal — `hash === '#/parent'` or `?parent=1` for standalone `ParentPortal` (~299–322); not a general SPA route table.

### 2) API client patterns

- **`/home/admin/frontend/src/supabase.js`** — custom `QueryBuilder` + **`API_BASE` = `'/api/v1'`**; mimics Supabase `.from().select()…` but calls Laravel. Exports **`supabase`** with **`from`** and **`auth`** (~510–514); session in **`localStorage.alltrue_session`** (see auth helpers ~492–496).
- **`/home/admin/frontend/src/api.js`** — **`fetch`** to **`/api/v1/*`** (e.g. parent APIs) plus some **`supabase.from('students')`** style helpers (~73+).
- **Pages** — many use **raw `fetch('/api/v1/...')`** with **`Authorization: Bearer`** from **`supabase.auth.getSession()`** (e.g. `StudentsList.vue`, `CourseManagement.vue`, `App.vue` `fetchProfile`).

### 3) Branch / campus state

- **`/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue`** — **`currentBranch`** ref (~497); **`watch`** persists to **`localStorage.setItem('app_branch', …)`** (~884+ per grep).
- **`/home/admin/frontend/src/lib/useBranches.js`** — singleton **`branches`** ref, **`loadBranches()`** (`GET /api/v1/branches`), **`loadBranchesForDirector(token)`** (`GET /api/v1/campuses`), **`resolveSavedBranchChoice`** for legacy `app_branch` ids (~81–100).
- **`ensureDirectorBranches()`** in App (~701+) merges director campus list with public branches fallback; **`currentBranch`** is passed as **`:branch-id="currentBranch"`** to page components.

### 4) Real-time libraries

- **`/home/admin/frontend/package.json`** — **`vue`**, **`@supabase/supabase-js`** (dependency present).
- **App code** uses the **custom** `supabase` from **`supabase.js`**, not a live Supabase Realtime client. No **`WebSocket` / `EventSource` / channel subscribe** usage found under `frontend/src`.
- **`@supabase/realtime-js`** appears only as a **transitive** lockfile dependency for `@supabase/supabase-js`, not as an app-level feature.
- **Near-real-time today**: **`setInterval`** in **`App.vue`** (~766–768) polls unread notifications every **60s** (`refreshUnreadNotifications`).

### 5) Chat page insertion + minimal shared UI

- **Insertion point**: add a new **`page`** key (e.g. `'chat'`) in **`sidebarNavGroups`** (and optionally **`mobileTabItems`** for directors/teachers) in **`/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue`**, then add a matching **`v-if="active === 'chat'"`** block with **`<ChatPage :branch-id="currentBranch" … />`** (mirror **`NotificationsCenter`** or **`LineIntegration`**).
- **New file**: **`/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.vue`** (or similar) keeps the same pattern as other top-level pages.
- **Reuse**: **`/home/admin/frontend/src/components/SearchableSelect.vue`**; **global styles** **`/home/admin/frontend/src/styles.css`**; **`guideTour`** / FAB pattern is already in **`App.vue`** (`currentGuidePage` ~548). **`course-management/`** modals are domain-specific, not generic chat.  
- **Auth pattern for API calls**: **`supabase.auth.getSession()`** + `fetch` with Bearer token, consistent with existing pages.

---

**Paths summary**

| Topic | Primary paths |
|--------|----------------|
| No router / active key | `/home/admin/frontend/src/main.js`, `/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue` |
| API client | `/home/admin/frontend/src/supabase.js`, `/home/admin/frontend/src/api.js` |
| Branch state | `/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue`, `/home/admin/frontend/src/lib/useBranches.js` |
| Dependencies | `/home/admin/frontend/package.json`, `/home/admin/frontend/package-lock.json` (transitive realtime) |
| Shared components | `/home/admin/frontend/src/components/SearchableSelect.vue`, `/home/admin/frontend/src/styles.css` |

[REDACTED]
